title: Rayong — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Rayong: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Rayong has a population of 70,000. An industrial and coastal city on the Gulf of Thailand, known for its fruit orchards, beaches, and as the gateway to Koh Samet island. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 94 sunny days a year.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
